plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to meet concentration limits and reduce risk.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU) to zero for capital preservation.
Sell SMH and CRWD to reduce high-beta tech exposure.
Maintain SPY and QQQ as core broad index holdings.
This plan aims for capital preservation and a large cash buffer.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta exposure, aiming for lower drawdowns. Expect reduced upside potential compared to other modes.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Sell SMH, METU, SOXL, and SPAL due to being below stop or leveraged.
Trim CRWD to 5% to reduce high-beta tech concentration.
Maintain SPY and QQQ as core broad index holdings.
This plan balances risk and growth, aiming for a smaller cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while maintaining exposure to quality tech and broad indices. Expect moderate drawdowns and growth potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Sell SMH, METU, and SPAL due to being below stop or leveraged.
Add to CRWD, pressing a working position.
Add to SOXL, increasing leveraged exposure within limits.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It utilizes leverage and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware that this mode significantly increases both upside potential and drawdown risk, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay.

plan: Add to QQQI, increasing exposure to income-generating ETFs.
Trim SPY to 10% and sell QQQ to reduce broad index exposure.

income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, focusing on yield and capital preservation. It rotates into income-generating ETFs and significantly reduces high-beta and leveraged exposure. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in market downturns.
